description: Form a STANDALONE US LLC (Wyoming or Delaware) — a real, state-filed company with its own EIN and registered agent. TWO packages: "agent_company" (default) bundles the Agent Charter (mandate, wallet authority, spending/risk limits) governing your AI agent; "standard_llc" is a REGULAR Wyoming LLC with an OPEN purpose (any lawful activity) and a standard document pack (Operating Agreement, resolutions, membership ledger, tax memo) — no Agent Charter, no agent spec required. Same price, same rails. TWO ways to pay: by CARD (returns a Stripe checkout_url the human owner opens) OR in USDC on-chain (the agent can pay autonomously). Returns a request_id and both payment options. Creates a REQUEST only — filing happens AFTER payment is confirmed. When an AI agent is involved it is an authorized delegate, never a member or a legal person; there is always at least one human principal.

agent.description: The autonomous AI agent the company owns and operates. REQUIRED for the agent_company package; omit for standard_llc. Never a member or a legal person.

description.description: What the agent does and its role (becomes the company purpose).

powers.description: Delegated powers, e.g. ["trade on DEXs", "pay invoices"].

prohibited_actions.description: Forbidden actions, e.g. ["no transfers to personal wallets"].

spending_limit_per_day_usd.description: Max USD aggregate per day without human approval.

spending_limit_per_tx_usd.description: Max USD per single transaction without human approval.

wallets.description: Company wallets the agent controls (bound in the Wallet Authority Schedule).

callback_url.description: OPTIONAL — an HTTPS endpoint the agent controls. We POST signed events there (payment.confirmed, filing.recorded, formed, annual_report.due) so you never need to poll get_formation_status. The create response returns the signing secret ONCE; verify X-OffshoreProz-Signature (sha256 HMAC of the raw body).

company_name.description: Desired company name (e.g. "Helios Capital"). "LLC" is appended for the filing.

company_name_alternatives.description: Backup names in priority order, if the primary is unavailable at the state.

company_purpose.description: Custom purpose clause for the Operating Agreement. Default: standard_llc → open purpose ("any lawful act or activity" under W.S. 17-29); agent_company → derived from the agent description.

diagnostic_id.description: If you ran agent_company_diagnostic first, pass the diagnostic_id it returned — links this formation to that assessment (helps us prioritize and pre-validate your intake).

ein_responsible_party.description: Responsible party for the EIN (IRS SS-4). Do NOT include SSN/ITIN here — those are collected securely out-of-band.

is_us_person.description: Whether they hold a US SSN/ITIN — drives the EIN path/turnaround.

jurisdiction.description: US state of formation. Wyoming only for now (Delaware coming soon). Wyoming: charging-order protection that extends to single-member LLCs (W.S. 17-29-503), no state income tax, and members stay off the public record.

mailing_address.description: Mailing address, if different from the principal office.

management_model.description: Who manages the LLC. For agent_company, the agent is a delegate under the Agent Charter regardless of this.

package.description: "agent_company" (default): the full Agent Charter pack governing your AI agent — requires the agent field. "standard_llc": a regular Wyoming LLC with an OPEN purpose and a standard pack (Operating Agreement, organizational resolutions, membership ledger, US tax memo) — no Agent Charter; the agent field is ignored.

primary_contact.description: Human contact. Email is required (card buyer + document recipient).

email.description: REQUIRED — the card checkout receipt, status updates, and document delivery go here.

principal_office_address.description: The LLC's principal office address (may be outside the US). Appears on the public Articles of Organization.

principals.description: Human principal(s) who own the company. At least one. The agent is NOT listed here.

is_manager.description: Whether this principal is a manager / controlling person.

name.description: Full legal name of the human owner/member.

tax_election.description: "none" (default): default US tax classification (disregarded single-member / partnership). "c_corp": the LLC will elect on IRS Form 8832 to be taxed as a C corporation from formation — e.g. a non-US creator selling through a US platform (Microsoft, Apple, Roblox) who needs the company to give the platform a Form W-9 and stop 30% royalty withholding. The document pack then carries the corporate tax clauses, Form 8832 guidance, and — for a foreign sole owner — a services and IP assignment agreement.

name: create_standalone_company
